description: Display identifier of the flagged minor arm, preserving the project naming.
Lowercase mature-miRNA identifier; use arm + gene as the unique key.
Lowercase identifier of the opposite arm from the same miRBase precursor.
Display identifier of the opposite arm.
Target-gene symbol used in the frozen project.
minor_arm: the arm with fewer validated targets in the original audit; not an expression-based or universal biological major/minor assignment.
val: non-test positive scored in its held-out validation fold; test: independent test positive.
1-based validation fold, 1 to 5; empty for independent test labels.
The gene is a validated target of both arms in the frozen positive-label set.
At least one canonical 8mer, 7mer-m8, or 7mer-A1 site for the flagged arm in the canonical 3UTR.
At least one canonical site for the opposite arm in the canonical 3UTR.
Highest site class for the flagged arm. none excludes a 6mer; 6mer is retained as a distinct class.
Highest site class for the opposite arm.
A CLASH source row for this arm/gene was detected in at least one WT library (WT_Detected_8 >= 1), at any target region.
The analogous CLASH indicator for the opposite arm and the same gene.
Both arms occur somewhere in the WT-detected CLASH source; not a declaration that this particular gene is bound.
other_arm_only: canonical site absent for the flagged arm and present for the opposite arm.
Rule-based flag for possible arm-annotation ambiguity; does not establish an annotation error.
